# Test Red-DiscordBot cogs

Loads and unloads cogs via RPC to verify they work inside Red-DiscordBot.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | ✅ | — | Discord bot token used when starting Red-DiscordBot |
| `cog_paths` | ✅ | — | Comma-separated list of cog directories to validate |
| `rpc_port` | ❌ | 6133 | Port Red-DiscordBot RPC server listens on |
